reason: #1022 turned a confirmed-clean spawn abort into StartAborted, which hid the original reason ('worker startup exited; inspect its private diagnostic log') behind a generic message and changed the timed-out start from TimeoutError, so two process-level tests in test_runtime_processes.py fail on main. StartAborted now keeps the operator-facing reason of a CoordinationConflict or RuntimeIpcError (other errors by type only), and the timeout test expects StartAborted caused by TimeoutError. Selected: the process-level spawn tests and automatic recovery, which consumes StartAborted.
exclusions: test_runtime_processes.py spawns real workers; locally it was run with a per-worktree Python 3.12 venv whose nebula resolves to this worktree. Under this host's load (load ~32) two cases timed out once and passed on rerun. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed.
